mapper.select: select rdo_id from edw.fact_returns_v4 where return_shipped_ts > '2024-06-10' and return_shipped_ts < '2024-06-13' and is_active = 1 and return_tracking_id is not null and rdo_id is not null

Select CONCAT('''',tracking_id) as tracking_id_long,tracking_id,product_id,po_id,fulfillment_delivery_do_id,pickedup_ts,expected_delivery_ts::Date, fulfillment_carrier_id,shipment_status,ship_date_ts::Date,delivered_ts ,original_promise_delivery_ts::Date ,current_promise_delivery_ts::Date from edw.fact_order_line_items foli where is_active=1 and order_status not in ('initiated', 'accepted') and fulfillment_carrier_id = 'pitneybowes' and line_item_status not in ('cancelled', 'suppressed') and physical_fulfiller_id = 'geodis' and product_type = 'physical' and delivered_ts > #{start} and delivered_ts < #{end};

Select CONCAT('''',tracking_id) as tracking_id_long,tracking_id,product_id,po_id,fulfillment_delivery_do_id,pickedup_ts,expected_delivery_ts::Date, fulfillment_carrier_id,shipment_status,ship_date_ts::Date,delivered_ts ,original_promise_delivery_ts::Date ,current_promise_delivery_ts::Date from edw.fact_order_line_items foli where is_active=1 and order_status not in ('initiated', 'accepted') and fulfillment_carrier_id = 'pitneybowes' and line_item_status not in ('cancelled', 'suppressed') and physical_fulfiller_id = 'geodis' and product_type = 'physical' and ship_date_ts > #{start} and ship_date_ts < #{end};

Select count (distinct tracking_id) from edw.fact_order_line_items foli where is_active=1 and order_status not in ('initiated', 'accepted') and fulfillment_carrier_id = 'pitneybowes' and line_item_status not in ('cancelled', 'suppressed') and physical_fulfiller_id = 'geodis' and product_type = 'physical' and delivered_ts > #{start} and delivered_ts < #{end};

Select count (distinct tracking_id) from edw.fact_order_line_items foli where is_active=1 and order_status not in ('initiated', 'accepted') and fulfillment_carrier_id = 'pitneybowes' and line_item_status not in ('cancelled', 'suppressed') and physical_fulfiller_id = 'geodis' and product_type = 'physical' and ship_date_ts > #{start} and ship_date_ts < #{end};

select DISTINCT upper(foli.po_id) as po_id,fulfillment_delivery_do_id as do_id ,foli.physical_fulfiller_id ,UPPER(foli.tracking_id) as tracking , current_promise_delivery_ts::Date as EDD, fgo.entry_ts as order_entry_date,fgo.updated_ts as ship_scan_date,fustv.origin_scan_ts - interval '5 hour' as origin_scan,HOUR(fustv.origin_scan_ts - interval '5 hour') as origin_scan_hour, out_for_delivery_ts - interval '5 hour' as out_for_delivery_scan, DATEDIFF('day',fgo.updated_ts,fustv.origin_scan_ts - interval '5 hour') as diff,delivered_ts::Date,fustv.estimated_delivery::Date from edw.fact_order_line_items foli left join edw.fact_geodis_orders fgo on foli.fulfillment_delivery_do_id = fgo.fulfillment_po_id left join edw.fact_ups_shipment_tracking_v4 fustv on foli.tracking_id = fustv.tracking_id where foli.is_active =1 and fgo.is_active = 1 and fustv.is_active = 1 and DATEDIFF('day',fgo.updated_ts,fustv.origin_scan_ts - interval '5 hour') > 0 and (DATE_PART('hour',fgo.updated_ts) < 19 and DATEDIFF('day',fgo.updated_ts,fustv.origin_scan_ts - interval '5 hour') > 0) and HOUR(fustv.origin_scan_ts - interval '5 hour') >6 and physical_fulfiller_id = 'geodis' and product_type = 'physical' and ship_date_ts >= #{start} and ship_date_ts <= #{end} and foli.fulfillment_carrier_id = 'ups';

select DISTINCT upper(foli.po_id) as po_id,fulfillment_delivery_do_id as do_id ,foli.physical_fulfiller_id ,UPPER(foli.tracking_id) as tracking , current_promise_delivery_ts::Date as EDD, fgo.entry_ts as order_entry_date,fgo.updated_ts as ship_scan_date,fustv.origin_scan_ts - interval '5 hour' as origin_scan,HOUR(fustv.origin_scan_ts - interval '5 hour') as origin_scan_hour, out_for_delivery_ts - interval '5 hour' as out_for_delivery_scan, DATEDIFF('day',fgo.updated_ts,fustv.origin_scan_ts - interval '5 hour') as diff,delivered_ts::Date,fustv.estimated_delivery::Date from edw.fact_order_line_items foli left join edw.fact_geodis_orders fgo on foli.fulfillment_delivery_do_id = fgo.fulfillment_po_id left join edw.fact_ups_shipment_tracking_v4 fustv on foli.tracking_id = fustv.tracking_id where foli.is_active =1 and fgo.is_active = 1 and fustv.is_active = 1 and (DATE_PART('hour',fgo.updated_ts) < 19 and fustv.event_status_code = 'mp') and physical_fulfiller_id = 'geodis' and product_type = 'physical' and ship_date_ts >= #{start} and ship_date_ts <= #{end} and foli.fulfillment_carrier_id = 'ups';

select a.*,b.cnt_total, 1-a.cnt_miss/b.cnt_total as otd from (select current_promise_delivery_ts::Date as edd,count(distinct foli.tracking_id) as cnt_miss from edw.fact_order_line_items foli where foli.is_active = 1 and current_promise_delivery_ts::Date >= TRUNC(Trunc(CURRENT_DATE,'IW')) and current_promise_delivery_ts::Date < CURRENT_DATE and product_type = 'physical' and physical_fulfiller_id = 'geodis' and (delivered_ts is null or (foli.delivered_ts - INTERVAL '6 hour')::Date > foli.current_promise_delivery_ts) group by current_promise_delivery_ts::Date) a join (select current_promise_delivery_ts::Date as edd,count(distinct foli.tracking_id) as cnt_total from edw.fact_order_line_items foli where foli.is_active =1 and current_promise_delivery_ts::Date >= TRUNC(Trunc(CURRENT_DATE,'IW')) and current_promise_delivery_ts::Date < CURRENT_DATE and product_type = 'physical' and physical_fulfiller_id = 'geodis' group by current_promise_delivery_ts::Date) b on a.edd = b.edd order by a.edd;

select foli.po_id ,fulfillment_delivery_do_id as do_id , foli.finance_plan_id, foli.shipped_sku, foli.shipping_amt, foli.physical_fulfiller_id, UPPER(tracking_id) as tracking, foli.order_dt::Date as order_date, current_promise_delivery_ts::Date as EDD, foli.delivered_ts::Date, foli.ship_date_ts::date, v.promised_ship_dt, foli.fulfillment_carrier_id, case when foli.carrier_service_name = '' then 'U2' else foli.carrier_service_name as service_level, shipment_status from edw.fact_order_line_items foli left join edw.fact_fulfillment_edd_v4 v on foli.line_item_id = v.line_item_id where foli.is_active =1 and v.is_active = 1 and current_promise_delivery_ts::Date = CURRENT_DATE -1 and product_type = 'physical' and physical_fulfiller_id = 'geodis' and (delivered_ts is null or (foli.delivered_ts - INTERVAL '6 hour')::Date > foli.current_promise_delivery_ts);

select a.edd, a.fulfillment_carrier_id as carrier, a.carrier_service as service_level, a.cnt_miss, b.cnt_total,
1-a.cnt_miss/b.cnt_total as otd from (select current_promise_delivery_ts::Date as edd, fulfillment_carrier_id, case when carrier_service_name = '' then 'U2' else carrier_service_name END as carrier_service ,count(distinct foli.tracking_id) as cnt_miss from edw.fact_order_line_items foli where foli.is_active = 1 and current_promise_delivery_ts::Date >= TRUNC(Trunc(CURRENT_DATE,'IW')) and current_promise_delivery_ts::Date < CURRENT_DATE and product_type = 'physical' and physical_fulfiller_id = 'geodis' and (delivered_ts is null or (foli.delivered_ts - INTERVAL '6 hour')::Date > foli.current_promise_delivery_ts) group by current_promise_delivery_ts::Date,fulfillment_carrier_id,case when carrier_service_name = '' then 'U2' else carrier_service_name END ) a join (select current_promise_delivery_ts::Date as edd,fulfillment_carrier_id, case when carrier_service_name = '' then 'U2' else carrier_service_name END as carrier_service ,count(distinct foli.tracking_id) as cnt_total from edw.fact_order_line_items foli where foli.is_active =1 and current_promise_delivery_ts::Date >= TRUNC(Trunc(CURRENT_DATE,'IW')) and current_promise_delivery_ts::Date < CURRENT_DATE and product_type = 'physical' and physical_fulfiller_id = 'geodis' group by current_promise_delivery_ts::Date, fulfillment_carrier_id,case when carrier_service_name = '' then 'U2' else carrier_service_name END) b on a.edd = b.edd and a.fulfillment_carrier_id = b.fulfillment_carrier_id and a.carrier_service = b.carrier_service order by a.edd;

select a.fulfillment_carrier_id as carrier, a.carrier_service as service_level, a.cnt_miss, b.cnt_total, 1-a.cnt_miss/b.cnt_total as otd from (select fulfillment_carrier_id, case when carrier_service_name = '' then 'U2' else carrier_service_name END as carrier_service ,count(distinct foli.tracking_id) as cnt_miss from edw.fact_order_line_items foli where foli.is_active = 1 and current_promise_delivery_ts::Date >= TRUNC(Trunc(CURRENT_DATE,'IW')) and current_promise_delivery_ts::Date < CURRENT_DATE and product_type = 'physical' and physical_fulfiller_id = 'geodis' and (delivered_ts is null or (foli.delivered_ts - INTERVAL '6 hour')::Date > foli.current_promise_delivery_ts) group by fulfillment_carrier_id,case when carrier_service_name = '' then 'U2' else carrier_service_name END ) a join (select fulfillment_carrier_id, case when carrier_service_name = '' then 'U2' else carrier_service_name END as carrier_service ,count(distinct foli.tracking_id) as cnt_total from edw.fact_order_line_items foli where foli.is_active =1 and current_promise_delivery_ts::Date >= TRUNC(Trunc(CURRENT_DATE,'IW')) and current_promise_delivery_ts::Date < CURRENT_DATE and product_type = 'physical' and physical_fulfiller_id = 'geodis' group by fulfillment_carrier_id,case when carrier_service_name = '' then 'U2' else carrier_service_name END) b on a.fulfillment_carrier_id = b.fulfillment_carrier_id and a.carrier_service = b.carrier_service order by carrier;
